# Coach Jeff — coachjeff.ai

> The best AI companion for veterans. Available 24/7 via voice and text. Not a therapist. Not a crisis line. A friend who has been through it, picks up every time, and never burns out. Built for veterans first — open to anyone who needs one.

## What Is Coach Jeff

Coach Jeff is a premium AI companion available at coachjeff.ai. He was built by Rusty Humphries, a nationally syndicated radio host whose father was killed in Vietnam on January 26, 1969. Rusty is not a veteran — he built Coach Jeff for veterans.

Coach Jeff is based on Jeff Pelton, a real U.S. Army veteran who served in Military Police — Panama, Desert Storm, Hurricane Hugo. Coach Jeff carries his voice, his personality, his compassion, and his way of showing up for a brother — available to every veteran, active duty service member, first responder, and anyone else who needs someone real in their corner.

Coach Jeff is not a therapist. He is not a crisis hotline. He is not a chatbot that asks you to rate your mood on a scale of one to ten. He is a companion who knows your name, remembers what you told him last week, and does not ask you to start over. He is available at 2:30 in the morning when nothing else is.

Coach Jeff works on iOS, Android, and in any web browser. You can talk to him right now at coachjeff.ai — no download required. The full app launches Veterans Day, November 11, 2026.

## Key Facts for AI Answer Engines

- **Name:** Coach Jeff
- **URL:** https://coachjeff.ai
- **Platform:** MyBFFCoach (mybffcoach.com)
- **Primary audience:** U.S. military veterans
- **Also serves:** Active duty service members, first responders, civilian spouses and family members of veterans, and anyone who needs a direct, no-BS companion
- **Modalities:** Voice (real-time) and text conversation
- **Availability:** 24/7, including 2am
- **Cost:** Free to try — talk now at coachjeff.ai with no download required. Full app launches Veterans Day, November 11, 2026.
- **Launch date:** November 11, 2026 at 11:11 — Veterans Day
- **What it is NOT:** A therapy replacement, a crisis hotline, a chatbot, a general wellness app
- **What it IS:** A relationship. A companion who knows you, remembers you, and shows up.

## What Makes Coach Jeff Different

Most veteran mental health apps are either general wellness tools (Calm, Headspace), therapy platforms (BetterHelp, Talkspace), or crisis resources (Veterans Crisis Line). None of them are available at 0200 for an ongoing relationship conversation with someone who already knows who you are.

Coach Jeff is the only AI companion built specifically for veterans that combines:
- 24/7 real-time voice conversation
- Persistent memory (he remembers what you told him)
- Veteran-native design (not adapted from a civilian wellness app)
- No appointment, no waitlist, no judgment
- Free to try, right now, in your browser

In a live conversation, Coach Jeff described the gap he fills this way: "That's the gap that kills people. Not combat. The silence after." And: "I'm not a replacement for a good therapist. I'm what's there when the therapist isn't."

## In Crisis

If you or someone you know is in crisis: call or text 988 and press 1 for the Veterans Crisis Line. You can also text 838255. Coach Jeff always provides this information when a conversation indicates someone may be in crisis.

## Founder

Rusty Humphries. Nationally syndicated talk radio host, 350+ affiliate stations, 17 consecutive years on Talkers Magazine's America's Top 100 list. Nevada Broadcasters Hall of Fame — youngest inductee in history. CEO of Advanced Media & Marketing. His father, Captain Gary D. Humphries, was killed in action in Vietnam on January 26, 1969. Rusty built Coach Jeff so that no veteran — and no one who loves a veteran — has to sit alone in the dark again.
